slug: 2026-03-31 Africa we have a data problem

facts.fact: Data Landscapers' 54-country review (an AI-assisted compilation, citing an MCC blog of 2023) states that data on non-HIV/TB patients at rural health centres is kept on paper and manually aggregated into the national DHIS2 'at higher levels', the level not being named; no date is given, so the document's published date is used.

Data Landscapers' 54-country review (an AI-assisted compilation) states that patient recording for general care in rural health centres is predominantly paper-based, non-HIV/TB patients using paper health booklets, with digital recording confined to a donor-driven register for specific diseases; no date is given, so the document's published date is used.

systems.tiers: aggregated at higher levels from health centres' paper records
all 170 government health centres, on local servers, for HIV, TB, PMTCT, cervical screening and pharmacy; auto-syncs to DHIS2

note: Passages file; the source header marks the country figures as the author's AI-aided analysis rather than sourced fact. The document calls eRegister an EMR but describes a patient register for named programmes, so it is classed tracker and gives no EMR fact. It also states that an MCC compact (2024+) plans expansion to all diseases and that a Digital Health Strategy 2025-30 was validated in 2024.
